mapper.sql: SELECT d.id, d.knowledge_base_id, d.current_version, d.name, d.source_format, d.mime_type, d.size_bytes, d.sha256, d.status, d.created_by, u.username AS created_by_username, d.created_at, d.updated_at, t.error_code, t.error_message FROM document d JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = d.created_by LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT error_code, error_message FROM document_index_task WHERE document_id = d.id AND document_version = d.current_version ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 ) t ON true
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document(id, knowledge_base_id, name, source_format, mime_type, size_bytes, sha256, object_key, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{file.name}, #{file.format}, #{mime}, #{size}, #{file.sha256}, #{key}, #{actorId})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{kbId} AND deleted = false
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{kbId} AND sha256 = #{sha} AND deleted = false)
SELECT object_key FROM document_storage_cleanup WHERE object_key = #{key} AND next_attempt_at = #{due} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE document SET deleted = true WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_version(document_id, version_no, name, source_format, mime_type, size_bytes, sha256, object_key) SELECT id, 1, name, source_format, mime_type, size_bytes, sha256, object_key FROM document WHERE id = #{id}
INSERT INTO document_cleanup_task(document_id,document_version,cleanup_type,next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{id},0,'DELETED',#{due}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE document_storage_cleanup c SET next_attempt_at = #{leaseUntil} WHERE c.object_key IN (SELECT object_key FROM document_storage_cleanup WHERE next_attempt_at <= now() ORDER BY next_attempt_at, object_key LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING c.object_key
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_version WHERE object_key = #{key})
